Name: Yokukiryo
Information:
**Yokukiryo**

The masked lover, otherwise called the yokukiryō, is a type of yokai that, more commonly than others, is born directly from the soul of a mortal. They can be born from a soul that has experienced rejection or lost love that sends their soul plummeting into the depths of anguish (rational or not). They are masked humanoid figures, bound eternally by a bone mask they cannot remove as an expression of feeling unwanted or incomplete. The yokukiryō seeks two things: to reclaim the object of their affections (the creature who rejected them or they lost), or to take hold of a mortal creature who either spurned another or was spurned. They are phantoms drawn to romantic anguish, and want to seize the love of another to feed on their anguish (which they believe drains the target of their despair and lets them rest).

Stat Blocks.title: Yokukiryo
languages: speaks Sylvan and the languages of its original self

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yokai uses its Grim Fixation, Longing Gaze, or Overreaching Grasp, then makes two weapon attacks.

actions.name: Grim Fixation
actions.description: The yokai chooses one creature it can see within 60 feet, who it dictates to be the source of its fixation. For 1 hour, as long as the target is within 60 feet of the yokai, the yokai can sense where the creature is and it cannot Hide from it. The target can benefit from cover from the yokai, but cannot be obscured by anything short of solid, completely opaque material. The yokai can interact with its target regardless of whether they are on the Material or Ethereal plane as if they were on the same one. The yokai cannot select a new fixation until their current one is dead or the current target hasn’t been within 60 feet for 1 hour.

actions.name: Longing Gaze
actions.description: The yokai subjects the target of its Grim Fixation to mental torture, as long as they are within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw, taking 14 (3d8) psychic damage and is stunned until the start of their next turn on a failure, or half as much damage and isn’t stunned on a success.

actions.name: Fiendish Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If this attack is made against the yokai’s Grim Fixation target, they are no more than one size category larger than it, and when it hits, they can automatically grapple them (escape DC 16). If the yokai is grappling their target already, this attack can deal psychic damage instead of slashing.

actions.name: Overreaching Grasp
actions.description: The yokai teleports to an unoccupied space adjacent to its Grim Fixation target, then the next attack they make against them has advantage. Alternatively, if they are grappling their Fixation target or in contact with them while they’re dying or unconscious, they can teleport themselves and their target to an unoccupied space within 30 feet.
